user.title: Connect to the Movistar Askey router
user.description: Enter the address and web-admin password for your router.

data_description.password: The router web-admin password, not the Wi-Fi password.
data_description.poll_method: Web interface (HTTP) or SSH console. SSH directly queries the router CLI without triggering web server memory leaks.

ssh.title: Configure SSH connection
ssh.description: Configure the SSH terminal connection to your Movistar Askey router.

data_description.ssh_username: The router SSH login username. Default 1234.
data_description.ssh_password: Leave blank to use the router admin password entered in the previous step.
data_description.ssh_port: The SSH port on the router. Default 22.
data_description.ssh_key_file: Optional file path to an SSH private key.

reconfigure.title: Change router connection
reconfigure.description: Update the router address or web-admin password.

data_description.password: The router web-admin password, not the Wi-Fi password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the router
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current router admin password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the router

data.signal_sensors: Client sensors (Wi-Fi signal, IP address, person, roams)

data_description.scan_interval: How often the router is polled. Default 300 seconds (5 minutes); minimum 30.
data_description.consider_home: How long a client stays home after it was last seen. Never shorter than the polling interval. Default 600 seconds.
data_description.tracked_devices: Select the devices to track for presence (e.g. phones or tablets). Only selected devices will have active presence trackers available to assign to a Person.
data_description.signal_sensors: Manual: enable each sensor yourself. Follow tracker: a client's sensors are enabled while its device tracker is enabled. All: every client gets enabled sensors. Sensors you disabled yourself are never re-enabled.
data_description.poll_method: Web interface (HTTP) or SSH console. SSH directly queries the router CLI without triggering web server memory leaks.
data_description.ssh_port: The SSH port on the router. Default 22.
data_description.ssh_username: The router SSH login username. Default 1234.
data_description.ssh_password: Leave blank to use the router admin password.
data_description.ssh_key_file: Optional file path to an SSH private key for authentication.

router_unreachable.title: Movistar router unreachable
router_unreachable.description: The last {failures} polls of the router failed ({error}). Device trackers use their presence grace period until the router answers again. Check that the router is on and reachable from Home Assistant. This notice clears automatically after the next successful poll.
